tools.name: search_prices
tools.description: Prices Australian sellers advertise on their own public pages, per kg, litre, dozen or each, excluding GST. Each result has the seller, the source link and the date it was read. Cheapest per-unit first. These are advertised prices, not a market rate: never average them. Each result has pack_kind (tr

tools.name: market_rates
tools.description: Median wholesale price per kg, litre or each, taken only from verified suppliers' own listings, and only where three or more verified suppliers list the product. Returns an empty list when no product has enough verified suppliers yet; then use search_prices.

tools.name: find_suppliers
tools.description: Suppliers listed on Suppliers Net, by what they sell and where. Returns name, categories, state, a profile link, and a status: verified (claimed and ABN matched), checked, claimed, or listed (from public records). No phone numbers or email addresses are returned; the profile page says how to contact

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: States and supplier categories with their supplier counts, and how many dated prices are current. Use it to pick a category or state that exists.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_prices" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
